nutrition.label: POOR (High Risk / Severe Malnutrition)
nutrition.coreStrategy: Aggressive, early, and medically supervised nutrition intervention to reverse malnutrition and preserve lean body mass
nutrition.clinicalActions:
Achieve energy: 30–35 kcal/kg/day
Achieve protein: 1.5–2.0 g/kg/day
Ensure oral intake ≥75% of requirement
Initiate oral nutritional supplements (ONS) early
If intake <50–60% → initiate enteral nutrition (EN)
If EN not feasible → consider parenteral nutrition (PN)
Monitor:
Weight (weekly)
Intake adequacy
Functional status
Correct fluid & electrolyte imbalance
Adjust nutrition based on treatment tolerance

nutrition.label: MODERATE (At Risk)
nutrition.coreStrategy: Early, preventive nutrition intervention to avoid progression to severe malnutrition
nutrition.clinicalActions:
Achieve energy: 25–30 kcal/kg/day
Achieve protein: 1.2–1.5 g/kg/day
Maintain oral intake ≥75%
Introduce ONS if intake is suboptimal
Monitor:
Weight trends
Intake decline
Early symptoms
Prevent muscle loss and fatigue
Adapt nutrition to treatment-related symptoms

nutrition.label: GOOD (Low Risk / Stable)
nutrition.coreStrategy: Maintain nutritional status and prevent decline during treatment
nutrition.clinicalActions:

Achieve protein: 1.0–1.2 g/kg/day
Maintain adequate oral intake
Monitor:
Weight stability
Appetite
Treatment tolerance
Provide early intervention if decline begins
